name: 20 More, Somehow Even Smaller, Mazes
description:
About This Game

This is a puzzle game with twenty small mazes.

I hope you enjoy it.

Around 30 minutes of play time, maybe.

Accessibility Information:

  • A few puzzles require knowledge of English.

  • No puzzle requires sound or audio to solve it.

  • No puzzle requires being able to recognize different colors.

  • There are separate volume sliders for each type of audio.

  • There are options for separate captions for every type of audio.

  • There is controller support and you don't have to push two buttons at the same time.
short_desc: A puzzle game with twenty small mazes.
